events.title: Company reports local consultation
events.excerpt: The project website describes a community consultation milestone in November 2022. This is the company's account, not an independent measure of community consent.

events.title: Construction permits reported
events.excerpt: Patagonia Gold says final permits to begin construction were received in November 2024.

events.title: US$40 million preferred-share financing
events.excerpt: The June 2025 financial statements report Black River Mine's investment in Patagonia Gold Canada for Calcatreu development and financing expenses.

events.title: Construction and drilling programme
events.excerpt: The project history describes 2025 construction work, including access and camp facilities, alongside drilling.

events.title: Third participatory water sampling reported
events.excerpt: Río Negro reported another round of water sampling. The article describes monitoring activity; it does not provide the laboratory results needed to assess water quality.

events.title: Environmental inspection at the project
events.excerpt: The province reported inspections of processing and leaching infrastructure. A reported inspection is evidence of oversight activity, not a finding of no environmental impact.

events.title: Province attends loaded-carbon sampling
events.excerpt: The provincial water department reported participation in sampling of activated carbon from the operation.

events.title: Local recruitment, training and safety
events.excerpt: A provincial working-group update describes recruitment, training and safety measures associated with Calcatreu.

controlNote: The filing identifies Carlos J. Miguens as controlling Black River Mine. This is a disclosed related-party connection.

distributionStages.description: 80% to BRM and 20% to PGL until BRM has received US$40 million.
Then 100% to PGL until PGL has received US$60 million.
Thereafter, 40% to BRM and 60% to PGL.
